definitionAudit.name: privateSeedPastInformation
definitionAudit.meaning: comap of omega -> (S omega, finite family Y_i omega for i in range t), with product measurable space. No quotient, no selection and no assumption that S/Y are ambient measurable. t=0 history is unique empty function.
definitionAudit.wholeCarrier: Every omega is mapped literally. No current or future coordinate is included.

definitionAudit.name: expectedFixedMinimum
definitionAudit.meaning: Real sInf of image of closed[0,1] by u -> integral of finite cumulative fixed-u squared loss. Infimum OUTSIDE the expectation. Not defined by a chosen minimizer.
definitionAudit.wholeCarrier: Totalized real Bochner integrals on all inputs, including nonintegrable functions. Genuine finite expectation/attainment must be derived under T4. At T=0 image={0}. Nonempty comparator set and nonnegative integrals give a nonempty bounded-below real image.

definitionAudit.name: expectedFixedRegret
definitionAudit.meaning: Integral of finite cumulative prediction squared loss minus expectedFixedMinimum. No feasibility, causality or nonnegativity baked into definition.
definitionAudit.wholeCarrier: Totalized real operation at every carrier input. At T=0 both terms zero. T4 supplies hypotheses for genuine bounded integrable losses.

definitionAudit.name: eventuallyMeasurableSpace F (ae μ)
definitionAudit.meaning: s measurable iff exists F-measurable r with s=r modulo ambient mu-null sets. It is a sigma-algebra by the ae filter countable-intersection property. Not an eventual-in-time claim.
definitionAudit.wholeCarrier: No F<=ambient requirement. Even with F<=ambient this can exceed completion of mu restricted to F, because ambient null sets need not admit F-measurable null supersets.

binderAuditPolicy.relativeContract: SOURCE below means an explicit hypothesis of the sealed derived/library mathematical contract, not an invented claim that Orabona printed it. Acceptance instead requires the explicit derived-support/general-library classification and all source deltas recorded here.

blindClarification.originalPhrase: not merely ALL t then AE omega
blindClarification.disposition: Clarified in this independent review; no statement or proof correction required.
blindClarification.interpretation: This can describe literal syntactic quantifier placement only. For natural times and a fixed chosen policy family, AE omega forall t is mathematically equivalent to forall t AE omega by countable intersection. No strict-strength claim is accepted. Extractor H-COMMON and current semantic report explicitly preserve this equivalence.

explicitSourceDeltas: T1 has no direct printed theorem anchor and belongs to general measure-theory infrastructure.
Completion/null-augmentation, seed representation, arbitrary information sub-sigma-algebras, measurable factorization and version choice are supplied model mathematics absent from both printed pages.
Source action/outcome support is pointwise game language; process hypotheses use AE feasibility and representation, while constructed T2 policies are feasible on every input.
The source expectation notation shows outcomes only; T3/T4 explicitly include a measurable seed independent of the whole infinite outcome process.
The exact sum-of-MSE identity and infimum of expected fixed scalar losses are derived refinements of the printed variance benchmark, not printed Eq1.1 verbatim.
Zero-based natural indices and T=0 are explicit Lean conventions; source normalized Eq1.2 requires positive T.
Source sublinear/average-vanishing success criterion and p3 FTL/empirical minimizer are not proved by these four contracts.
